name: Gerund vs. infinitive
note: Some verbs take -ing (enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, suggest, keep). Some take to + infinitive (want, decide, hope, promise, offer, agree). After prepositions always use -ing. A few (stop, remember, try) change meaning with each form.
